create_MultivariateNormalTri: create a MultivariateNormalTri distribution with a loc vector and triangular scale matrix
test_MultivariateNormalTri_sample: test sampling from a MultivariateNormalTri distribution with batched loc and scale_tri parameters
test_MultivariateNormalTri_log_prob: test computing log_prob of values against a MultivariateNormalTri distribution with upper or lower triangular scale
test_MultivariateNormalTri_methods: test entropy, mean, stddev, variance, covariance, and mode methods on a MultivariateNormalTri distribution
test_MultivariateNormalTri_kl_divergence: test kl_divergence and cross_entropy between two MultivariateNormalTri distributions with broadcasted batch shapes
